# Your Next Customer Won't Click

> A Devcon 8 talk by Fortunato Cinquepalmi (Product Lead, Kleros), Agentic Hub, Mumbai, 4 November 2026, on designing for humans and agents. The agent's channel is getting wider. The human's is getting narrower. Design what crosses the narrow one.

The talk has three parts (then: you read the page; now: your agent reads the docs; already starting: the agent acts on its own) and ends with a checklist: what the agent should get, what the human should see, where trust is earned. Every number in it has a source. Nothing here asks you to sign up or buy anything.

## The talk

- [The talk for agents](talk.md): the thesis, the three parts, the checklist and the sources, as Markdown
- [The talk for people](index.html): the same talk as one web page

## Sources

- [Cloudflare, Markdown for Agents](https://blog.cloudflare.com/markdown-for-agents/): 16,180 tokens as HTML, 3,150 as Markdown
- [Ahrefs, llms.txt study](https://ahrefs.com/blog/llmstxt-study/): 97% of llms.txt files got no requests in May 2026
- [Reflex, computer use vs structured APIs](https://reflex.dev/blog/computer-use-is-45x-more-expensive-than-structured-apis/): the same task through the screen and through an API
- [Microsoft, Magentic Marketplace](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.25779): first-proposal bias in a simulated agent market
- [Kleros Scout agent instructions](https://scout-app.kleros.io/llms.txt): a live agent door on a product with a human UI
